evidence.focused-visual: pass: image, initials, long-name, action and disabled paint are computed locally
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Showcase removable Person Tag updates real DOM state
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: label ellipsizes while avatar/action remain fixed in a narrow root

realInteractionVisual: pass: real remove hover, pointer-down active, keyboard focus-visible and disabled computed paint are asserted
runtimeBehavior: pass: pointer, Enter and Space each emit exactly one native click; disabled emits none and removal updates consumer state

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: remove pointer hover/down, Tab focus, Enter, Space, disabled and narrow long-name surfaces inspected
